grok_report.summary: Core facts (Fed hike, 10Y yield at/above 5%, tech pressured) are accurate but the briefing presents a 4-day-old Fed decision as same-day breaking news, which is a material framing/staleness issue. No factual errors found in individual stock prices or watchlist mood tags. Missing context includes the FOMC's forward guidance on further 2026 hikes, which is arguably more market-moving than the hike itself at this point.
